title: Code and Simulation Artifacts: Physics-Guided Surrogate Optimization and Load-Compensated Multivariate Fault Monitoring of a Coastal Hybrid Wind-Solar-PEM Green Hydrogen Plant
description: Simulation scripts, surrogate models, NSGA-II optimization, and PCA fault detection algorithms for a coastal hybrid wind-solar-PEM green hydrogen facility under multi-year meteorological uncertainty.
